rationale: Enterprise 10.4 READ THIS FIRST describes complete removal; the versioned 10.4 TLS guide documents a disabled-by-default, restart-required temporary opt-in. The Enterprise 10.6 upgrade notes remove the opt-in. The current source register already maps both 10.4 sections to the original HF claim; TLS 1.2 or higher remains the inter-Splunk action. This does not apply the same behavior to Universal Forwarders.
